pages.text: Ridiculous and pitiful. The Frost Heart that the old wretch guarded for centuries was ultimately nothing more than a bridal gift for others. The hermit spent his entire life meticulously sculpting and nurturing such a divine object, yet until his death he refused to unlock its true power.
If he had dared to crush this heart, the entire snowy plain would have experienced the arrival of absolute zero — all things annihilated, none spared.

But he did not dare. He could not bear to part with it. And so, all of this fell into the hands of a dark sorcerer. Now, every ice spell will be steeped in bone-piercing cold. Every living thing touched by it — flesh or soul alike — will forever remain frozen in stasis. Go, show this world the Frozen Throne.
